nom: Paula's Choice Resist Daily Pore-Refining Treatment 2% Bha

avis.titre: The one piece in resist line I couldn't live without
avis.texte: I use all of this daily pore exfoliant along with the resist perfectly balanced cleanser, resist toner, resist spf 50 day fluid moisturizer and nighttime clear skin hydrator and LOVE them! I am 34 with fair, combination skin that breaks out incredibly easy. I have used these products for 6 months now and have not had one zit. Yes; I am not kidding you! This has not happened in my entire adult life! This exfoliant is my favorite piece in the regimen and would the one piece I would use if I had to pick one. Since I use this twice a day I go through it pretty fast. My results though are due to the entire line. I will say that I did not like the light antioxidant serum as it made my skin feel greasy. I got my sister to use this and after a month she loves it as well. If you enter Paula's choice website using the text below with https:// in front of it and deleting the specs on between you will automatically get $10 off and you still can stack on any other promo code you find! goog.gl/ Fkc8KB

avis.titre: Everything Paula’s Choice is a Godsend
avis.texte: Just get it, it’s literally perfect. I own two 3 Paula’s Choice products and although they’re a bit pricey, it’s honestly so worth it. Ever since getting products by Paula’s choice, I have not had insanely horrible textured skin like I used to and I have not broken out with huge cystic under the skin pimples. Her products also help to get rid of little annoying bumps on my forehead that are probably a result of my super oily skin. You most likely won’t be disappointed, just be very consistent using it and you’ll never look better :)
I use this daily and it has worked amazing. No smell a little on the pricy side but well worth it. I also have very oily skin and this helps so much! 10/10
It helps with enlarged pores, but start early in your life to correct your pores, don’t wait till your over 60 to try and fix it, it will take time …..love Paula’s items

avis.texte: I’ve been dealing with skin thats prone to closed comedones and occasional breakouts, and this 2% BHA exfoliant has transformed my routine. I apply it right after shaving and showering, and I’ve noticed fewer ingrown hairs, less clogged pores, smaller-looking pores overall, smoother texture, and blackheads nearly gone without irritation. It works well alongside my LED light therapy. The lightweight, watery formula absorbs instantly in the morning, feels soothing and slightly moisturizing, and doesn’t dry me out like harsher exfoliants might. It penetrates pores effectively to unclog them and refine skin, giving a radiant finish that pairs well with sunscreen. I put a moisturizer on top of it (CeraVe PM). For the price, it’s a staple for oily, acne-prone folks. No strong scent, cruelty-free, and results build steadily. Highly recommend if you’re optimizing your skincare.
Works against breakouts! I have noticed some improvement on pores. Not as much as I would like but I haven’t been using that long. I will buy again just because of how much it reduces breakouts.
Love this! Works great for my skin. Leaves me feeling very fresh, my skin thanks me!
Love this product. I’ve tried many toners and blackhead treatments. This by far has helped minimize my pores and blackheads and I don’t even have to use it daily!

Thelse products have changed my skin completely. I do not recognise the texture of my skin they are so excellent!! The only down side is I think that the Amazon markup is what pushes this product out of reach of the regular budget!!! I'm delighted and will next be purchasing the CLINICAL....meaning that there is real irrefutable proof that the skin care works. Well done Paula

This really works well. My face was breaking out and this helped me clear it up. When I first used it, my face got worse for 2 days as it seemed to be taking out the impurities in the skin and then my face pores got smaller and my skin got clearer. All of this product line is great

avis.titre: Moreover I do not see a great visible change after using it
avis.texte: This is an okay product. The product claims that it controls breakout, in fact I started breaking out on my jaw line after continued use. Moreover I do not see a great visible change after using it. Nevertheless , for the price I paid for this, I still include it in my nightcare regimen.

avis.titre: Gutes Produkt - tägliche Anwendung ganz einfach
avis.texte: Das Produkt kam termingerecht und war sicher Verpackt. Die Anwendung ist einfach, ein Wattepad wird auf der Packung empfohlen und ist auch notwendig, da das Produkt doch sehr dünn ist. Dies war eine Überraschung, ist jedoch ein Problem. Ich verwende das Produkt täglich, seit 2 Wochen, noch ist kein richtig sichtbarer Effekt ersichtlich, aber ich verwende es bestimmt weiterhin. Der Geruch ist auch nicht unangenehm.

avis.titre: The best face product I have ever used
avis.texte: This product is a must have. I was hesitant to buy a $35 toner because it seemed a little expensive but I am so glad I did. I took a picture of my face before starting this product and then one a week after use. I’m so happy. It was a little drying to my skin at first so I only used it at night and still worked great.

avis.titre: Stay away unless you want boils and breakouts !!
avis.texte: Worst product ever. My skin texture was nice and smooth and I didn’t have any break ups. This is after one week of using this product. I am devastated. It looks like I have two boils on the side of my cheek. I am so disappointed

This does reduce pores but only when the solution is on your skin. Then it turns your face into a war zone. I have combination skin and have mild acne. Just look what this stuff did to my cheek!! I never have clustered acne like this. I do not recommend this product if you are prone to acne at all. Sadly, another product I am returning.
